text.div:
SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

  • Intramuscular cyanocobalamin 1000 micrograms daily for one week, weekly for four weeks, then monthly for life
  • Hematology consultation to confirm pernicious anemia, review the cytopenias and neurologic findings, and advise on replacement and gastric risk
  • Monitor the response on the CMID schedule: reticulocytes at one week, potassium during early replacement, blood count and MMA at eight weeks, and a neurologic examination at each visit; no routine repeat B12 level
  • Upper endoscopy with topographic gastric biopsies to confirm autoimmune gastritis and look for neuroendocrine tumors and gastric neoplasia, with H. pylori testing and TSH for autoimmune thyroid disease
  • Treat iron deficiency unmasked by recovery with alternate-day oral iron, and complete the GI evaluation with colonoscopy
  • Chronic low back pain: eight weeks of supervised exercise therapy and a home program, heat, and tai chi; an NSAID as needed once the platelet count is normal; no imaging without red flags
  • Fall prevention: neuropathy and gait checks at each visit, strength and balance exercise, night lights, and home-safety review

resource.title: Annie Oakley synthetic care plan
resource.description: Diagnose pernicious anemia with early neurologic involvement in a slight, active woman of 64; replace B12 by injection and confirm the response on the CMID schedule; stage autoimmune gastritis by endoscopy for gastric neoplasia and neuroendocrine tumors; recognize the iron deficiency that recovery unmasks; and manage chronic low back pain from old injuries with exercise-first ACP care while checking neuropathy and fall risk.

Treat iron deficiency unmasked by recovery with alternate-day oral iron, and complete the GI evaluation with colonoscopy
Chronic low back pain: eight weeks of supervised exercise therapy and a home program, heat, and tai chi; an NSAID as needed once the platelet count is normal; no imaging without red flags
Fall prevention: neuropathy and gait checks at each visit, strength and balance exercise, night lights, and home-safety review
